name: Roo Code
notes: Roo keeps every custom mode in one .roomodes file and merges: entries whose slug starts with waypost- are ours, everything else is left alone. Roo now prefers YAML but JSON is documented as fully supported and not deprecated, so waypost writes JSON — it can be produced and re-read without a YAML parser, and this tool ships no dependencies. If your .roomodes is already YAML, waypost refuses to touch it rather than converting it; convert it to JSON or invoke roles with `waypost agents show`. groups read+command keep the mode read-only apart from the shell.
